name: billcraft
idea: BillCraft is a free, browser-only professional invoice generator that lets freelancers and small businesses create, customize, and download polished PDF invoices in seconds — no signup, no backend, no data ever leaves the device.
why_trending: Freelance economy searches are surging in 2026: NerdWallet, Jobbers.io, and Conta all published 'best invoice software for freelancers 2026' roundups this month, signaling massive search-intent. Wave, Invoice Fly, and FreshBooks dominate but charge $10-50/month, leaving millions of solopreneurs searching for a genuinely free, no-friction alternative. 'Free invoice generator' sees 400K+ monthly US searches with high commercial intent.
why_profitable: Monetizes via Google AdSense targeting high-intent freelancer/small-business traffic (CPMs $8-15 for B2B/finance audience). A 'Pro' upgrade ($9 one-time) unlocks additional templates, logo upload, and recurring invoice scheduling. Affiliate links to FreshBooks, QuickBooks, and Wave for users who outgrow the free tool add passive revenue. Comparable tools (Invoice Ninja, Zoho Invoice) convert 5-10% of free users to paid.
why_easy: 100% static HTML/CSS/JS with zero backend — jsPDF (loaded from cdnjs CDN) generates print-quality PDFs entirely client-side. LocalStorage persists drafts across sessions with no database. The entire app is a single index.html file: customizable accent colors, 5 templates, line items with per-item tax rates, global discount, shipping, and bank/payment details. Deployable to GitHub Pages or Netlify in under a minute.
